en: The image displays a night or early evening scene with a grand building featuring multiple towers and domes, situated on a lakeshore. There is a large paddle steamer or vintage boat on the water in the foreground, with the building illuminated by many yellow-lit windows. Behind the building, towering snow-capped mountains dominate the background, and a dense forested area separates the lake from the mountains. The image has a painted or tinted photographic quality typical of early 20th-century postcards.
